285, down 3 from 288, all three units in point_of_sale/models/pos_session.py and all three this change's.

:518 _check_pos_config ran one search_count per session inside `for session in self`; one _read_group over self.config_id.ids now. A FOURTH query-inside-a-for disappears with the deletion of the dead get_total_discount and is NOT one of the three: there the search is the loop's ITERABLE, evaluated once, so the gate never counted it. An AST walk over the For node does count it, which is how this pass briefly reconciled "four removed" against a delta of three. A query inside a loop and a query that produces the loop are the same syntax and opposite facts.

STAMPED AT THE PARENT, NOT AT THE COMMIT THAT LOWERS IT. ratchet.py --update refuses a dirty tree, and the commit this floor belongs to did not exist when the measurement was taken.
